source.title: The work by Ray Chandra Bose on the representation of non-Desarguesian projective planes: further developments and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with identifier 6004043. Local zbMATH-derived queue metadata and exact-title search results identify the work as A. Barlotti, "The work by Ray Chandra Bose on the representation of non-Desarguesian projective planes: further developments and open problems", J. Combin. Inform. System Sci. 17 (1-2) (1992), 171-174.

failure_mode=metadata_only with local network_or_dns_failure. The zbMATH URL was treated as a resolver, not as the technical source. The browser fetch for https://zbmath.org/6004043 did not expose readable article text, and local shell fetching of zbMATH/API endpoints failed because DNS resolution is unavailable in the sandbox.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery using the zbMATH id, the exact title, the title plus PDF/author terms, and the journal citation with page range. Inspected candidate search results included the MacTutor Raj Chandra Bose biography, almerja mirrors of that biography, a Docsity bibliography page for Adriano Barlotti, and unrelated document-hosting results. These were rejected because they were citation lists, biographies, bibliography pages, snippets, or different works, and none exposed a readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work artifact was recovered. Extracting questions from the title, bibliographic references, metadata, search snippets, or related biographies would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6004043.json and outputs/latest.json.
